content_of_post_to_comment: I think I and many others suffer from underlying issues that make us this way. We‘re suppressing our emotions instead of dealing with them and getting better. Standard escapism.
comment: The escapism part hits on something a lot of people miss: avoiding emotions can feel like relief in the moment, but it usually keeps the same problems waiting underneath. I’ve found that even just naming what I’m trying not to feel can break the cycle a bit. The hard part is figuring out whether you’re actually resting or just avoiding something.
